package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

// Answer statuses.
const (
	StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress  = 1
	StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview = 2
	StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed      = 3
	StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected    = 4
	StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed      = 5
)

// StudentTaskAnswer represents student attempt.
type StudentTaskAnswer struct {
	ID                 string
	LearningPathItemID string          `json:"learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	RequirementID      string          `json:"requirement_id,omitempty"`
	FrozenTaskJSON     json.RawMessage `json:"-"`
	StudentID          string
	TaskID             string
	FilestorageID      *string
	AnswerPayload      json.RawMessage
	StartedAt          time.Time
	EndedAt            *time.Time
	Status             int
	Attempt            int
	CreatedAt          time.Time
	UpdatedAt          time.Time
}

// StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview stores automatic review result.
type StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview struct {
	ID                  string
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	CheckedAt           time.Time
	ValidatorName       string
	AutoScore           *float64
	Passed              bool
	Feedback            *string
	RawResult           map[string]any
}

// StudentTaskAnswerReview stores manual review result.
type StudentTaskAnswerReview struct {
	ID                  string
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	ReviewerID          string
	CheckedAt           time.Time
	FinalScore          *float64
	Status              int
	Feedback            *string
}

// StudentTaskProgress aggregates progress for one task.
type StudentTaskProgress struct {
	TaskID         string
	HasPassed      bool
	HasUnderReview bool
	LatestStatus   int
	LatestAnswerID string
}

// TaskTestAnswerVariant stores one chosen answer variant for one test question in one attempt.
type TaskTestAnswerVariant struct {
	ID                  string
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	TaskID              string
	TaskTestID          string
	TaskTestVariantID   string
	SubmittedOrder      *int
	SubmittedGroupID    *string
	IsCorrect           bool
	CreatedAt           time.Time
}
